card.name: Partway through rare drug and Latin words
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle or ending piece of a longer, uncommon word, such as the 'al' in prucalopride and sincalide, 'LOC' in demeclocycline, or 'oyal' in Loyal. Also fires on 'locality' and 'isation' after a 'local' or 'type' stem.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name split into several parts, mostly in label headings or dosing text.

modes.label: Legion motto and 'local' words
modes.description: A piece of 'Loyal' in a Roman legion title, or a word built on 'local' such as locality or localisation.
modes.example: The Sixth Victorious Legion, L<<oyal>> and Faithful

card.writes: No clear link to the output; the promoted and suppressed tokens are a mix of unrelated fragments.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long or unusual words, especially drug names like prucalopride, as the word is still being spelled out.
